description: Evidence ordering policy (register F16). Comparison is lexicographic over the ordering axes: claim authority first, then context equivalence, then runtime generation, then freshness. Freshness is LAST: a fresh observation from an unproven or unequal context can never override a context-equal higher-tier observation. Contradictions that policy does not explicitly resolve remain visible in the DecisionRecord — they are never collapsed.

tiers.meaning: a real provider turn / real delivery acknowledgement in the serving context
an exact-path canary executed in a context proven equal to the serving context (F15 receipts, environment-faithful)
privileged runtime diagnostics (diagnostic health projection, live PID provenance)
credential/file/keychain visibility in a NAMED context; proves presence in that context only
configuration declares it; proves intent, not function

rules.rule: A fresh lower-tier or context-unequal observation cannot override a context-equal higher-tier observation; it may only OPEN A CONTRADICTION, which stays visible.
Evidence whose execution context cannot be proven equivalent to the serving context classifies inconclusive or context_mismatch, never fail (F15/F16).
public projection scope supports transport liveness only; it can never support an identity, auth-bond, provider, release, or recovery verdict (F01 family).
configured/requested/resolved values never satisfy an observed claim (F10/F18); runtime_observed requires live-process or receipt-bound evidence.
Evidence does not survive process restart, redeploy, credential re-pair, config change, or roster-generation change for claims bound to those generations (F02/F19).
Subjects with binding.authority=unresolved never merge with any other subject and never contribute to another subject's coverage denominator.

incident.recovery_verified requires incident.recovery_gate_satisfied=pass in the same process+credential generation; any clear-requirement mismatch withholds recovery authority regardless of announcements.
administratively_aged_out closes bookkeeping, not the underlying claim; it never produces recovery_observed or recovery_verified.
Chat/alert notifications (BOT ERRORS channel) are transport, never evidence authority; only acked outbox/state artifacts and direct observations count.

context_equivalence.rule: Contexts are equivalent only when every compared field present on BOTH sides matches; a field present on one side only leaves equivalence UNPROVEN (inconclusive), not unequal.
